claims.text: About 21 degrees up, in the south-east sky.

Venus is low in the south-east before dawn on Thursday, about 21° up at 06:30 local time. Jupiter is up in the south-east in the small hours of the same day. On Wednesday evening Uranus reaches opposition and is visible in binoculars. Positions computed for central Europe (50°N, 15°E) with astronomy-engine. Narration uses a synthetic voice.
